THE DEFECT: guards.yml's push run is the repo's ONLY post-merge check -- a PR's checks ran on the merge REF, not on the commit the squash produced. Its concurrency block NAMED the hazard ('Never group push/merge_group by ref alone without the event -- cancelling a main-branch run would lose the post-merge signal') and the expression beneath it did exactly that: it included the EVENT, so a push could not cancel a PR run, and keyed the rest on github.ref, which is the SAME value for every push to main. One push to main therefore cancelled the previous one. The fix reached the instance and not the class.
